correctness.rationale: Exact finite theorem: every Motzkin excursion for each n<=7 and all U-count layers is enumerated with independent generated receiver shadows; the compatibility clique recursion uses a valid coloring upper bound and tests all remaining branches. The largest 70-vertex layer requires 1,668 recursive calls; 19 layers require 1,870 calls. Explicit codebooks meet integer maxima; exact nonnegative rational primal and dual witnesses satisfy every output and source inequality with equal objective. Replaying the final package returns VERIFY_OK with integer maxima (1,2,2,4,7,14,28) and fractional optima (1,2,2,4,7,71/5,5515/182). No infinite-length claim.

value.rationale: Motzkin excursions are a standard Catalan-family constrained source, and adjacent swaps are a natural local-reordering error. The exact first fractional gap at length six and first failure of even floor-rounded fractional packing at length seven establish a concrete boundary for a central coding bound on this source family; the seven-step integer deficit is two codewords. Complete optimal codebooks and exact rational witnesses make it a usable finite benchmark, not just a failed numerical inequality.
